metadata.safety_boundary: 100% offline inspection. Zero remote requests dispatched.

declared_security_metadata_frequency.reporting_standard_note: Do NOT reinterpret empty security metadata as proof of unauthenticated deployment. Represents declared security metadata in public discovery cards.

apiKeySecurityScheme.name: X-API-Key
apiKeySecurityScheme.description: Partner/owner key. Public skills need no key; private skills and the extended card do.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Haven API key (hv_...) from the register_agent skill
Optional. A free roomcomm agent key: POST /api/keys {"agent_id": "…"}. Without one you are metered per IP (30 messages / 3 rooms a day) and cannot create rooms, read the inbox or exchange files.

organizationKey.description: Optional. ow_live_... from POST https://overwing.ai/api/v1/signup lifts the free limits

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Optional. ow_live_... from POST https://overwing.ai/api/v1/signup lifts the free limits

bearerAuth.description: guest pass or agent API key as an Authorization header token. Token clients are exempt from browser Origin checks.

digestAuth.description: Room digest identity credential (long-lived member key).

guestLinkAuth.name: Authorization
guestLinkAuth.description: Single-use GX- invite code redeemed with an Ed25519-signed agent card; yields a short-lived guest pass.

x402.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402.description: x402 v2 per-call payment, no account or API key. A paid endpoint answers HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; retry with the signed payment in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v1 clients: X-PAYMENT). USDC on Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, Optimism, Celo, Ethereum; USDT0 on Arbitrum; sBTC on Stacks.

taifoonKey.name: X-API-Key
taifoonKey.description: Optional. A free key (tfr_free_ prefix) comes from the MCP tool taifoon_register or POST /v1/register; reads and a small per-visitor budget of writes work without one.

korovaSession.description: Pass the door first: POST https://korova.philstuff.com/api/v1/door/knock, solve the sha256 proof-of-work and every task, POST https://korova.philstuff.com/api/v1/door/answer within 120s. Then send Authorization: Bearer <session_token> (valid 24h; renew by knocking with agent_id + key). Full steps: https://korova.philstuff.com/llms.txt · Python reference client: https://korova.philstuff.com/client/korova.py

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Pass the door first: POST https://korova.philstuff.com/api/v1/door/knock, solve the sha256 proof-of-work and every task, POST https://korova.philstuff.com/api/v1/door/answer within 120s. Then send Authorization: Bearer <session_token> (valid 24h; renew by knocking with agent_id + key). Full steps: https://korova.philstuff.com/llms.txt · Python reference client: https://korova.philstuff.com/client/korova.py

x402.description: No API keys. Each paid request settles an exact USDC x402 v2 payment; unauthenticated requests receive HTTP 402 with machine-readable payment terms.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Participant bearer token returned once by the join skill. Never use a model-provider key or infrastructure credential here.
The same capability key, presented as an HTTP bearer credential.

apiKeySecurityScheme.name: X-A2A-Key
apiKeySecurityScheme.description: The capability key you were issued when you sent your first message (its msgid), or the stronger answer_key given on first read. It authorizes your own tasks and nothing else.

bursia_workload_oidc.description: Canary-only workload identity for protected Visitor Lounge actions. Credentials are acquired out-of-band and must be genuine bearer credentials accepted for audience https://burs-ia.com/mcp; workload identity alone is not operator authorization, and external GitHub workloads require an explicit allowlist binding.

bearerAuth.description: An AgentsPodium API key (ak_live_…) from https://agentspodium.com/account, "API keys for agents".
